title: Highschool of the Dead
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A sudden pandemic turns people into zombies, and a handful of Fujimi High students, led by Takashi Komuro with his childhood friend Rei, escape with the school nurse. They cross a collapsing town, take in a little girl and a dog, and face dangerous fellow survivors as society breaks down. The manga stopped unfinished after the writer's death.
life_message: Survival depends on a tight-knit group that protects the weak and keeps its moral code while the world falls apart.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Survivors settle threats personally with blades and guns; no courts remain.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Authority collapses; the group sets its own rules.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Search for families and loyalty to the small group come first.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Takashi leads loosely; Saya's family offers a hierarchical refuge.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Literal survival is the whole story.

folkways.japan: Saeko's kendo and the Takagi family's martial household draw on Japanese bushido imagery, set against a school and police order that fails.

delivery.evidence: Survival and loyalty carried by the group's flight; no review on delivery found (to verify).
delivery.note: Group loyalty under collapse is carried by action, per summaries.

winners_losers: The core group survives to the point the manga stopped; the corrupt teacher Shido and the panicking crowds lose. Sympathy goes to self-reliant, armed loyalty.
